supporting_evidence.summary: significant deviations in scope [all services]: currencyservice_latency-50 z=408.44 (2042.2%); frontend_latency-90 z=103.51 (692.6%); checkoutservice_latency-90 z=82.07 (580.9%); frontend_latency-50 z=69.5 (643.4%)
traces for currencyservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 0.14->0.14ms (0.99x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 5.13->204.83ms (39.9x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: Its latency-90 deviation (z=82, E1) is far smaller than currencyservice's latency-50 deviation (z=408, E1). Checkoutservice calls currencyservice, and inbound calls to currencyservice rose 39.9x (E2), so checkoutservice's latency is downstream propagation.

Frontend's deviations (z=103 and z=69, E1) are much smaller than currencyservice's (z=408, E1). The pattern fits callers inheriting slowness from currencyservice (E2), not frontend saturating on its own.

proposed_fix.description: Check for and remove any network delay rule (e.g. tc netem or chaos experiment) on the currencyservice pod or network interface. Verify that callers' latency to currencyservice returns to about 5ms p50.
